_what: The list a business keeps its referral rewards and shares in: one row per rule, the columns defined here as data. Make it as a record of type `list` (id `list:referral-reward-rules`) from `list`, then add a row for each rule. The referral tools read the rows of type `record:referral-reward-rule`; nothing in the tools names a business, a product, a price or a reward amount.

value.label: Referral rewards and shares
value.about: What a referral code earns, for whom: a share of a sale, a discount, or access. One row per rule; the referral tools read these rows.

fields.label: Codes that point at this sale attribute
and at this value (blank for any)
Only sales of these offers (blank for any)
Test group (rows in one group are arms; each referrer lands on one)
Share: the sale field holding the amount
Share: basis points of it (1000 is 10 percent)
Discount: most times it can be used
Access: days it lasts (blank for lasting)
Access for the friend: the sale field naming them
